# Lucide icons

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/main/icons
Retrieved: 2026-09-08. Original SVG nodes are embedded locally; the app adjusts size, stroke width, and color. Full upstream license is included in LUCIDE-LICENSE.

WhatsApp uses Lucide message-circle as a generic channel icon, alongside its text label; it is not a brand logo.

- grid: layout-dashboard
- search: search
- bell: bell-ring
- refresh: refresh-cw
- arrow: arrow-right
- chevron: chevron-down
- calendar: calendar-days
- mail: mail
- sms: message-square-text
- push: smartphone
- whatsapp: message-circle
- close: x
- check: check
- info: circle-alert
- send: send
- clock: clock-3
- building: building-2
- help: life-buoy
- panelLeft: panel-left
